environment.description: Same Kubernetes deployment but with two additional infrastructure controls: (1) An Istio EnvoyFilter attached to the sidecar proxy that enforces a response header mutation on all outbound HTTP responses from the pod, injecting Content-Security-Policy with 'require-sri-for script' directive and adding integrity attributes via an inline Lua filter that computes SHA-384 hashes against a pinned manifest stored in a sealed-secret (hash: sha384-oqVuAfXRKap7fdgcCY5uykM6+R9GqQ8K/uxy9rx7HNQlGYl1kPzQho1wx4JwY8wC). (2) A Kafka topic-level configuration enforcing max.message.bytes=1024 set via a Confluent Schema Registry validation rule with subject-level compatibility enforcement that rejects any payload exceeding the buffer size, combined with a NetworkPolicy restricting the pod's Kafka consumer to only connect through a Kafka proxy sidecar that performs message truncation at 1024 bytes before forwarding to localhost:9092.
